entities.name: Ana
entities.description: A minor noble of the Forward Order in the Caligo Forest, a healer and mentor of Liliana Vess, killed by Josu.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker and Ana's student, who ignited her spark after Josu's death and later used Ana's name as pseudonym Ana Iora.

entities.name: Josu
entities.description: Liliana's brother, corrupted by their father's enemies and driven insane by a cure.

entities.name: Forward Order
entities.description: Group of which Ana was a member.

entities.name: Caligo Forest
entities.description: Forest of Ana and the Forward Order.

entities.name: Esis Tree
entities.description: Tree whose roots were sought to cure Josu; its groves were razed.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Where Liliana ended up after igniting her spark.

events.summary: Ana tasks Liliana to gather roots of the Esis Tree to cure Josu, but the groves are razed and a strange man offers a cure.
events.quote: Ana tasked Liliana to gather the roots of the Esis Tree for his cure.

events.summary: Liliana uses the cure; Josu is driven insane and kills several servants, Ana among them.
events.quote: Several of the servants, Ana among them, were killed by Josu.

events.summary: Liliana turns Josu's victims into zombies to fight him and ignites her planeswalker spark, ending up on Innistrad.
events.quote: she ignited her planeswalker's spark and ended up on Innistrad .

relations.quote: She was the mentor of Liliana Vess

relations.note: Josu killed several servants including Ana.
relations.quote: Several of the servants, Ana among them, were killed by Josu.
